I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj run --compiled`, and Example 1 printed exactly the expected output. I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs.

The cache is two parallel lists, keys and values, kept with the most recently used entry first. With a capacity of at most 50, the linear searches are fast enough.
